international.notes: The university’s international office publishes mobility, exchange-student and foreign-student information. The Medicina curriculum includes a subject named “COMUNICACIÓN EN INGLÉS”, but no official source reviewed states that a medical subject is delivered with English as its language of instruction.

profile_paragraphs: UCSC’s Faculty of Medicine was created in 1996, initially as the Faculty of Health Sciences, beginning with Medicine and Nursing.
The Medicina curriculum places its first four years at Campus San Andrés in Concepción and its final three years in clinical fields in Chillán.
Hospital Las Higueras in Talcahuano is a UCSC Faculty of Medicine clinical field and hosts several UCSC specialty programmes. Its adult-medicine ambulatory centre lists rheumatology.
Hospital Clínico Herminda Martín has been UCSC’s Chillán clinical field since 2001; the faculty reported in April 2026 that the Hospital Regional de Ñuble would take over that role.

For a foreign rheumatologist, UCSC offers an identifiable teaching-hospital rheumatology clinic, but no UCSC rheumatology specialty programme was confirmed in the official sources reviewed. Current academic vacancies were not displayed.
